cardOverview.overviewText: The SBI Cards & Payment Services Limited PhonePe (Purple) Credit Card is a basic, low-fee co-branded card that gives up to ~3% value-back on PhonePe spends, ~2% on other online spends and ~1% on all other transactions, with easy-to-achieve fee waivers and simple digital rewards redemption.

items.title: Discover Reward Points Redemption Options
items.subtitle: To explore the full range of redemption options for this card, download the SaveSage Club app now.
